summary_en: 9,058,000 shares (0.69% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on June 2, 2026 at closing price of ¥3,538/share. Part of broader ¥250B, 156.5M-share (11.88% S/O) program authorized April 30, 2026 for May 2026–March 2027 execution via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Matching Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On June 1, 2026, Kyocera announced a single-day treasury share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours matching trade) on June 2, 2026. The company will place a buy order at the previous day's closing price of ¥3,538/share for up to 9,058,000 shares (0.69% of outstanding shares, excluding treasury stock). This block acquisition forms part of a broader ¥250 billion capital allocation program authorized by the board on April 30, 2026, which permits acquisition of up to 156,544,000 shares (11.88% of S/O) over the period May 1, 2026 through March 24, 2027 via both ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases under a dealer arrangement. The June 2 transaction will be executed during the morning trading session (8:45 a.m.) and results published immediately after close. Subsequent acquisitions under the authorized program will continue through the execution window, with the remaining budget and share authorization calculated after deducting this block.
